# Parked at solution: the first non-code ticket cannot reach non-code mode

The solution template carries `tests_first` as a non-empty list, so the solution gate requires it of
every ticket. Non-code mode is declared at tdd, which comes after. A ticket with no executable
behaviour therefore has to write tests it will never run in order to reach the stage where it says it
has no tests, and the only ways through are to invent them or to write a sentence explaining their
absence in a field that asks for a test command. Both are the placeholder the gate exists to refuse.

This is the first time it could show. SEEN-086 was exempt as the bootstrap, and every ticket since has
been code. SEEN-102 is the first policy ticket to run the harness, and it found the hole on its second
gate.

The decision this ticket exists to record is already made and already in the journal at record 3. What
is blocked is the paperwork around it, which is the right thing to be blocked on and the wrong thing to
work around.

So it parks, SEEN-103 moves the mode declaration to the solution stage, and this ticket advances after,
the same way SEEN-096 parked twice for SEEN-100 and SEEN-101. Three tickets now, each one a gate that
was wrong rather than a record that was.
